newsitem.title: USA: Clintons sing carols at Christmas benefit.
newsitem.headline: Clintons sing carols at Christmas benefit.

text.p: The president and Hillary Clinton joined celebrities and a local choir in singing traditional Christmas carols at an annual holiday benefit Sunday night.
The Clintons were the guests of honour at "Christmas in Washington," a holiday concert that raises money for the Children's National Medical Centre.

Washington's Eastern High School Choir and celebrities including singers Faith Hill and Luther Vandross performed holiday tunes for the first couple and hundreds of other guests at the ornate National Building Museum.
The Clintons later took the stage to sing along with "Hark the Herald Angels Sing."
In brief remarks, the president urged the audience to reflect during the holiday season on ways to help children and bring peace throughout the world.
"This time of year, more than any other time of year, gives us all a chance to celebrate our children," he said.
Actor John Lithgow and other members of the cast of the television programme "Third Rock from the Sun" presided over the event, which was taped for broadcast Saturday by NBC.
